scope.evidence_basis: Actual original-source comparison and local derivation reread: For m>n each dyadic cell of u_n contains an even number of alternating u_m cells; the signs differ on half the interval. Thus ||u_n-u_m||L1=1, whereas K(u_n)=1 for K(x)=x^2. This is a genuine counterexample to recovering input compactness, not to Maitre.

N-image-only: Calculate the pairwise L1 separation of dyadic sign functions and their constant squared images.

findings: For m>n each dyadic cell of u_n contains an even number of alternating u_m cells; the signs differ on half the interval. Thus ||u_n-u_m||L1=1, whereas K(u_n)=1 for K(x)=x^2. This is a genuine counterexample to recovering input compactness, not to Maitre.
